acceptance: The check fails on a deliberately broken anchor (demonstrated) and passes on the current tree; any pre-existing dead anchors found are fixed in the same PR or listed with evidence
The check runs on PRs that change Markdown (existing lint/CI wiring), with unit tests for slug edge cases (duplicate headings, punctuation, case)
Runtime over the tracked Markdown set is measured and reported; it adds no network access
PR merged with CI and oracle verdict green on its final head
context: The site converter reported exactly one dead anchor at the time, already fixed. If the checker finds many pre-existing failures, stop and report the count before fixing them all.
description: Issue #3448 was a dead docs anchor: #3435 renamed a heading in guides/tpc/tpc-h-official-guide.md and docs/advanced/power-run-concurrent-queries.md:490 kept the old anchor; only the site build caught it (fixed by #3480). Owner decision 2026-10-26: add a core-side check. Scope: links from tracked Markdown files to anchors in other tracked Markdown files (and same-file anchors if cheap); resolve GitHub-style heading slugs; ignore external URLs, code spans and generated files the repo already excludes elsewhere. Extend an existing checker/CI lint step if one fits rather than adding a new workflow job. Guardrails (all items): primary clone read-only; work only in a linked worktree from origin/develop (make worktree-create + make agent-write-preflight); never git add -A or git stash; identity Joe Harris, no agent attribution; never bypass hooks by any route; no code comments/docstrings (make comment-policy-check clean); encoding="utf-8" on file/subprocess text I/O; uv run -- for Python; no CHANGELOG entries; never weaken or delete tests or gates; TEST LOCK: never set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK or BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR, never run make test-unlock, xdist only under the shared lock; for make pr-open put ~/.cache/omp-18.12.1/bin first on PATH; make pr-preflight once, make pr-open, make pr-arm; never post oracle comments or rerun the oracle; commit/PR text for a reader who never saw this session (no item ids or plan labels).
